UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile synchronized from Google Authentication (Firebase Auth).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified Google account email address (PII - owner/admin only).

photoURL.description: Profile picture URL from Google account.

role.description: Access control role. Self-assignment of admin is strictly forbidden.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent sign-in.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted RBAC administrator registry document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

grantedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted privileges.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Strictly restricted to owner and verified admins.

/admins/{userId}.description: Admin RBAC registry. Read/write restricted strictly to verified admins.
